heading: INT. PARAANE EMERGENCY COORDINATION CHAMBER – NIGHT
boundary: Years later. Monsoon floods have cut through Kendhalaa.
He does not look away when the crisis counter reaches zero.

env6.visual_rule: Physical emergency-command chronology only; no represented/Parallel-Earth layer without packet evidence.

characters.PARVARAN: coordinates hospitals; still consent/procedure-aware but signs emergency integration
characters.MARSYAA: mentor/observer; insists temporary link + sunset clause

resolve.bindings: ENV-PAR-007 physical room. Buildings/services remain physically distinct; only command/data/route integration merges.

shots: Establish emergency coordination chamber at night, years later
Monsoon floods cut through Kendhalaa on literal holographic maps
Contaminated narcotic batch medical emergencies spread across districts
Young Asana directs Sarjanya rescue vehicles
Asana reports Rescue Drone Seven wrong route
ASANA: Rescue Drone Seven is showing the wrong route again.
Dispatcher says it follows moving heat source
DISPATCHER: It is following a moving heat source.
Asana says it identified buffalo as citizen
ASANA: It has identified a buffalo as a citizen.
Dispatcher says technically resident of Kendhalaa
DISPATCHER: Technically, it is a resident of Kendhalaa, sir.
Asana says rescue it after it votes
ASANA: Rescue it after it votes. First send the drone to the people inside the bus.
Hold brief human relief in crisis room
Anarvaa orders police transport/hospital triage/Sarjanya logistics under one command
ANARVAA: Link police transport, hospital triage and Sarjanya logistics under one command.
MARSYAA: We need a written sunset clause.
Parvaran looks at rising casualty count
Parvaran proposes signing now/review in 72 hours
PARVARAN: Let us sign it now. We will review it in seventy-two hours.
Marsyaa warns emergency power does not return by itself
MARSYAA: Power taken during an emergency does not return by itself after the emergency ends.
Parvaran says he will review it
Parvaran weighs casualty count and document
Systems begin merging at command/data level
Sarjanya routes appear inside government command
Keep physical institutions separate despite integrated data
For one night integration saves hundreds
Anarvaa watches power of a single command
Marsyaa remains wary of authority structure
Parvaran remains bound to signed review promise
Exact SC008 end: Anarvaa does not look away from single-command power
